objective: Verify bootloader-only scenarios, recovery patch integration, virtual MRAM failures, and stock restoration.

criteria.description: Automate pinned assets/scenarios, noninterference with original runtime, result classification, and negative tests.
criteria.finding: Boot runner 8/original runner 14; final six native runs, audit 55.

criteria.description: Confirm actual original boot selection paths and termination/rejection for clear, pending, and corrupt markers.
criteria.finding: Nine runs covering original clear/corrupt marker branches and pending success/ROM error/0- or 1-word interruption/stuck under the declared 16-byte virtual ROM. Confirmed pending/cleared/main selection on new original reset from original SWPOR store → actual metadata result. Even clearing one word enters main; ROM errors twice leave pending/POR repeating. Actual ROM/POR propagation and valid full OTA installation unverified; default guards unchanged; audit 105 after cleanup.

criteria.description: Distinguish actual boot handling of invalid main SP/reset/range from faults and unsupported boundaries.
criteria.finding: Nine isolated ARM cases for original SP bit-29 predicate; two native cases (exact reject branch/invalid-address SP handoff); original handling/model boundaries classified using existing reset faults. This is not a claim that all vectors are safely rejected.

criteria.description: Confirm natural path from research patched boot reset through worker/main.
criteria.finding: Existing fallback preserved. Synthetic B0/trim1 original patched reset → manager → worker/HELO → main natural path and hash/guard/observation audit 39 complete. Not physical revision/analog calibration certification.

criteria.description: Actual same-board UART2 authentication, invalid authentication, timeout and retry handling.
criteria.finding: Final six native runs confirmed original reset → UART2 FIFO → normal/error/no-input/normal after wrong/normal after partial timeout authentication → main on the same synthetic B0/trim1 board. Original HMAC/session/receive hash, actual OKAY and RLSD, watchdog kick/mismatch rejection, DWT restore, and IOM7 cleanup. DWT 10 MHz, virtual initially running PMIC and ignored 2-byte mock explicitly declared; default unknown rejection retained; audit 104. Not physical compatibility.

criteria.description: Same-board recovery command completion → natural main entry and original control.
criteria.finding: Same-board original UART LOAD264/RUN/API3 recv → stock 2.3 MRAM function → explicit 16-byte ROM model → original readback/progress/RESULT/CONT-RLSD/main. Two corrupt 16-byte restorations; full main hash matches original; stock boot entry-context control under same model; ROM 7/0 bytes/original 08000107/main. C# 41/host 9/independent 71 plus reaudit 71. Distinct from prior readonly diagnostic; not actual Boot ROM/physical certification.

criteria.description: Verify explicit virtual contract and original calls for MRAM request/alignment/permissions and success/failure.
criteria.finding: Original M55 wrapper/ABI for explicit 512-byte main body, virtual ROM success/failure, nine new native runs. Actual ROM permissions unverified.

criteria.description: Verify changed bytes at each update interruption point and boot selection after a new reset.
criteria.finding: Original ARM full-main writer interrupted at 0/4/64/68 words → actual MRAM transfer → new boot reset SP rejection branch in four cases. One case retaining valid vectors handed off/entered main despite incomplete main; risk documented. Subsequent CPD idle unsupported; not physical power accuracy.

criteria.description: Protect boot/metadata/neighbors during failure/interruption and reject invalid writes.
criteria.finding: M55 direct store added to Program API 23/atomic 8 found four changed bytes due to a post-hook defect. After blocking executable I/O write boundary, all MRAM remained unchanged for STR four targets plus STRB/STRH two; four existing actual ARM regressions passed. Declared virtual policy complete; not silicon permissions.

criteria.description: Virtual stock application restoration, full main hash, and natural reboot.
criteria.finding: Stock 2.4 full main 3700068-byte SHA; original M55 writer body/vector-last → actual MRAM → patched boot reset → stock main → 576x288 guest frame. Succeeded with initially cleared FFFFFFFF profile; marker 0 preserved at ROM power boundary. Not physical or same-board authentication integration.

criteria.description: Virtual full-stock restoration, hashes of all changed persistent components, and reboot.
criteria.finding: In virtual original 4 MiB, main retained from existing ARM restoration output. Original main callback 39 pages/OTA verifier 39 runs restored full 159744-byte boot; full 4 MiB SHA 8e0e4761 matched → new stock boot reset/main/576×288 frame succeeded. Existing resident self-overwrite failure preserved. Zero tail is synthetic original; ROM functional model/diagnostic caller, not natural OTA/physical/full-ROM certification. Audit 89 after independent cleanup; default 4 KiB normal/ROM error regressions.

criteria.description: Version-specific boot/main/recovery combination table, repetition, and rejection of unsupported combinations.
criteria.finding: Ten pinned artifacts/nine combinations; per-task machine-readable table and actual bytes gate. Of 24 boot/main pairs × seven tasks = 168 decisions, only eight verified allowed/160 rejected; source-only/unknown/physical rejected. Existing 2.3/2.4 recovery/writer/key pairing reused; cross-combinations rejected. Supported 2.4 virtual full-stock fresh 39-page restoration/original verifier/full 4 MiB/new stock boot-frame repeat matched. Other-version restoration/physical/certification remain unverified and are not allowed.
